resources.string: Synchronizes the headphone output with the main TV volume, including zero volume and mute.
Enable this accessibility service to automatically synchronize the headphone output with the main Philips TV volume, including mute.
Keeps the headphone output synchronized with the main TV volume, including zero volume and mute. Use the controls below to inspect the current levels or synchronize manually.
To enable automatic synchronization with the TV remote, turn on Philips Headphone Volume Sync in Accessibility settings.
Read-only mode: no changes were made.
Control built-in TV speakers (Philips-specific setting). Headphone volume sync remains active. Bluetooth and HDMI output modes are not controlled here.
Readback does not match requested setting.
Experimental Philips API operation. Confirm the current audio output is set to TV Speakers or TV Speakers Off. This change may interrupt audio. You can restore the setting in Philips TV Settings.
Turn the built-in TV speakers on or off. Headphone volume synchronization continues to work independently. This option does not select Bluetooth or HDMI audio outputs.
Change the built-in TV speaker state using the Philips audio API? This may briefly interrupt the sound. You can also restore the setting in Philips TV Settings.
